niche_preference_profile: Prefers calm, polished interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, generous breathing room, restrained color use, and consolidated content modules. They often favor editorial or guided presentation with immersive imagery when it supports a refined, aspirational feel, but consistently reject clutter, fragmented card stacks, loud accents, and overly busy utility styling.

criteria.description: Prefers open spacing, calmer pacing, and layouts with clear separation rather than dense stacked content.
Prefers muted accents, fewer competing colors, minimal iconography, and an overall visually quiet presentation.
Prefers strong headline-to-detail hierarchy, clear section separation, and focal points that make the screen easy to scan.
Prefers fewer, larger, more unified panels or modules instead of many small cards, nested boxes, or fragmented treatments.
Prefers softer rounded surfaces, subtle borders/dividers, and a delicate polished presentation over harsh, chunky, or aggressively outlined components.
